name: smwsprites-line-guided-rope-v1
title: Line-Guided Rope v1.1
description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 64 in SMW, the line-guided rope. The extra bit determines whether the rope will be short or long, but unless you use the No Sprite Tile Limits patch, it will always be short.

now SA-1 hybrid.

Support for LM3 exlevel settings. Only works with pixi 1.2.4+
